summary: The ad targets first-time air travelers, highlighting the potential embarrassment of not knowing English at the airport. It showcases the PW Talk app as a tool to practice essential airport-related English phrases with Hindi translations. The CTA urges users to download the app to overcome their fear of speaking English.
